retrievalProfile.description: A desaturated urban portrait featuring a male subject in winter attire with high-contrast gold and white sans-serif typography positioned in the upper right quadrant.
triggerTerms: urban winter portrait with gold text
cold outdoor portrait with metallic typography
excludeWhen: serif or script typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man in a dark jacket and grey hoodie looking intensely at the camera, set against a blurred, snowy urban background with a cool, blue-tinted color grade and metallic gold text accents.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame
Typography is vertically stacked and right-aligned in the upper right negative space
Cool-toned background contrasts with warm gold text elements
Low-angle perspective emphasizes the subject's presence
coreInvariants: Metallic gold texture on primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned off-center to the left, scaled to a medium-close-up shot from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's direct gaze and the high-contrast gold text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down to the hands/phone, then sweeps up to the right-aligned text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper right and lower right, utilized for typography and logos.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold (primary title text and logo accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark clothing and the bright snowy background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit saturation to the gold accents only

characterSpecificRedesigns: V in title often replaced with a glyph resembling a Roman numeral or stylized chevron
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic sans-serif pairing using weight and texture contrast.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory sticker in bottom center
Stylized sun/crown logo in bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric clarity and modern urban feel
Classic geometric proportions for wide tracking

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a man in a dark jacket and grey hoodie looking at the camera in a snowy, blurred urban environment with a cool blue-grey color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned uppercase sans-serif text in the upper right. Apply a metallic gold texture to the main title and a semi-transparent white to the subtitle. Place a parental advisory logo at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Does the main title have a gold texture?
Is the background desaturated and cool-toned?
Is the tracking wide on all text elements?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color grade
postGenerationChecks: Check that gold texture does not look like flat yellow
Ensure subject's face is the primary focal point
Verify that the 'V' in the title is stylized if applicable
Confirm the blue-grey tint is consistent across the image
Check that the right-alignment of text is precise
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Cool Grade + Gold Geometric Sans (Right Aligned)
